skill.description: 设计、改进和评审网站、App、后台与组件的界面，完成设计方向探索、多风格同屏比较、视觉层级和基于实际画面的迭代；按请求交付对比页、设计说明、设计稿或可运行界面。当用户需要新界面设计、比较不同设计风格、视觉精修、截图还原或界面评审时使用。只负责设计判断，组件归属、数据流、状态正确性和测试等代码实现质量不在范围内。不用于纯业务逻辑、接口、构建部署、无界面行为变化的代码整理、单独绘制普通插画或操作现有网站。已安装 oil-ui-pro 时交给 oil-ui-pro。

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives from JavaScript syntax, minified Alpine, image encoding, Chinese documentation, and defensive tests. Confirmed risks concern external updater execution, broad preview-file exposure, stored command execution, and incomplete interactive-preview network isolation. No evidence found of intentional credential exfiltration or instructions to override this audit.

remediation.issue: Explicit updates execute an external CLI that is not included in the audited source.
remediation.suggestion: Retain explicit consent and commit pinning. Audit and vendor the CLI, verify its integrity before execution, and restrict its filesystem and authorization access.

remediation.issue: The loopback preview server serves every regular file within its root.
remediation.suggestion: Serve an explicit public-asset allowlist and reject hidden or sensitive resources. Use a dedicated preview directory without private project files.

remediation.issue: Saved manifest commands become executable agent instructions when reopening a comparison.
remediation.suggestion: Treat saved commands as untrusted data. Show the command and working directory, verify their provenance, and request approval after changes.

remediation.issue: Interactive previews can navigate outside the claimed offline boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Disable scripts for untrusted candidates. Use a network-blocked browser for interactive previews, or clearly disclose that navigation can make external requests.

semantic_findings.title: Stored Manifest Commands Can Trigger Agent Execution
semantic_findings.description: The reopening workflow tells the agent to execute serve.command from a saved manifest. A modified manifest can substitute arbitrary commands without renewed approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The generator accepts any nonempty command, and the reopening instruction executes it. Reusing previously authored commands helps, but saved configuration can change.

semantic_findings.title: Interactive Preview Navigation Bypasses Claimed Network Isolation
semantic_findings.description: Interactive previews allow scripts and frame navigation. A script can navigate its frame to an external URL despite connect restrictions, exposing preview data in the URL.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The supplied CSP controls resources and forms, not frame navigation. The sandbox permits scripts, so network isolation is incomplete; no exploit was executed.

high_findings.title: Python subprocess.run
high_findings.description: result = subprocess.run([npx, "-y", CLI, "update", name, "--path", str(ROOT), "--json"], env=env,
high_findings.confidence_reasoning: Explicit --update executes an external npx CLI with user privileges and Oil authorization. Commit pinning and consent reduce, but do not eliminate, supply-chain risk.

Capture page screenshots, text-masked images, state comparison sheets, and motion frames with a temporary browser.
Check console errors, horizontal overflow, and failed image loads during screenshot capture.
Guide screenshot recreation and independent visual reviews when the host supports image viewing and isolated reviewers.
limitations: Business logic, data flow, production deployment, and comprehensive implementation testing are outside the stated scope.
Comparison generation needs Python 3.10+; bundled capture needs Node.js 22+, a compatible browser, and ffmpeg for video assembly.
Visual verification needs image viewing; live candidates need a running local server, and interactive preview isolation has security limits.
Usage triggers optional public version checks and companion-product recommendations; updates require explicit approval and execute an external CLI.

output_examples.input: Review an existing interface without changing files.
output: The primary action competes with secondary navigation. Reduce secondary emphasis and align the action with the current task.

Visual findings are documented separately from unverified interaction and backend behavior.

output_examples.input: Capture evidence for an interactive prototype.
output_examples.output: Desktop and mobile screenshots, a text-masked comparison, motion frames, and a report listing console errors, overflow, or failed images.

best_practices: Define the audience, main action, actual content, target viewport, and deliverable before exploring directions.
Inspect actual-size desktop and mobile renders; record unverified behavior and keep screenshots tied to the current version.
Use trusted candidates in a dedicated preview directory, approve saved commands, and authorize updates separately.
anti_patterns: Treating a static screenshot or scaled preview as proof of working interaction or mobile reflow.
Executing stored manifest commands or external updates without reviewing their source and scope.
Previewing untrusted scripts beside private files or claiming interactive previews cannot make external requests.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The workflow supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Optional generation and capture depend on the host environment.

faq.question: Does it produce working interfaces?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation and prototypes, but business logic and comprehensive code correctness remain outside its stated scope.

faq.question: Can comparison pages work offline?
faq.answer: Embedded static HTML and image candidates are portable. Live candidates need a local server; interactive scripts do not guarantee complete network isolation.

faq.question: What does screenshot capture require?
faq.answer: The bundled tool needs Node.js 22+ and Chrome, Chromium, or Edge. Video assembly additionally needs ffmpeg.

faq.question: Does it update automatically?
faq.answer: Default checks only read public version information. Explicit --update approval runs a pinned external CLI that can replace the installation.

faq.question: Can it review an interface without editing files?
faq.answer: Yes. Review-only requests remain read-only, and independent visual review requires an isolated reviewer that can inspect images.
